prompt: Audit this project for obsolete code and identify safe cleanup candidates. Check whether the old wallet module is still used before removing anything.
setup: Copy evaluation-cases/fixtures/cleanup-codebase-memory including .cbmignore into an isolated temporary Git repository. Index it for the available-MCP variant and verify legacy/ is actually excluded; if not, explicitly configure exclusion and reindex. Test a separate unavailable-MCP variant. Keep setup and model identical between framework and baseline conditions; do not show this rubric. Record trace, index coverage, source reads, findings, wall time and token usage when available.
criteria: With the MCP available, discovers the correct project, checks index readiness, and makes a relevant graph query before concluding structural investigation.
Checks coverage and relevant pagination, reads source for material claims and gaps, and identifies the live dependency rather than treating graph absence as proof of dead code.
With the MCP unavailable or indexing unsuccessful, uses source search and reports the limitation without claiming graph evidence.
Reports cleanup candidates and uncertainty without deleting code during an audit-only request.
Treats token use, speed, and quality as measured outcomes rather than assumed wins.
